name: zero_division
description: Average of an empty list: the summary crashes on days with no orders.

input.error:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "main.py", line 2, in <module>
    summary([])
  File "stats/metrics.py", line 9, in summary
    return {"count": len(values), "total": sum(values), "average": average(values)}
                                                                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "stats/metrics.py", line 5, in average
    return sum(values) / len(values)
           ~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
input.description: The daily dashboard crashes on days with no orders. An empty day should show an average of 0.

expect.check:
from stats.metrics import average, summary
assert summary([])["average"] == 0, summary([])
assert summary([])["count"] == 0
assert average([2.0, 4.0]) == 3.0
assert summary([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]) == {"count": 3, "total": 6.0, "average": 2.0}
